remaining_questions.question: Which vowel is under the chet: patah (candidate) or a single hiriq dot (לְחִבּוּל)? In line07 and band2 the mark under ח looks to me like one dot rather than a bar. The noun חִבּוּל ('in destruction') would also fit. At this resolution I can't rule out a faint bar, so I haven't patched it.

Which vowel is under the tav: sheva (candidate) or segol (אֲמִתֶּךָ, as in the pausal form of Ps 30:10)? The marks under ת in line14 and band3 look like more than two dots to me, but they are too small to settle it. Dagesh in the tav is present in both readings.

verdict: PDF284-285 has been fully proofed against the corrected wide bands, the full-height line crops and both native page images. The English (s285) matches the candidate word for word. The Hebrew consonants, maqafs, defective spellings and dageshes match throughout. No meteg anywhere on the page needed a change. There are two qamatz patches, for the pausal לָיְלָה in printed lines 8 and 9, and two single-vowel questions still open: the vowel under the chet of לחבול and the vowel under the tav of אמתך. Pointing is not approved until those two are settled.
